status:waiting-for-relay

Web-app relay client

Speaks the shared relay page protocol (postMessage ↔ relay ↔ SW). Which SHELL it talks to is picked by the ?marker= query param: localmdConnect (default — the localmd Connect extension, the protocol's only carrier since WebCLI 0.3.0) or webcliRelay (WebCLI ≤0.2.0 / dev builds) — both serve the same webcli:'mcp' envelope, distinguished only by their DOM marker / ext id. If this page's origin is in that extension's popup Web app access list, the flow below runs by itself on load: relay ready → initialize → tools/list → one read-only tools/call. Every step lands in #status; if the relay never announces (origin not added, or removed), that is recorded too — the negative case is as observable as the positive one.
